question: 如果4个身高1.1米的儿童，3个身高1.3米的在校学生，1个71岁的老年人，2个65岁的老年人，一同去神农溪景区+纤夫文化走廊（全景游），需要花费多少钱？

steps.description: Locate the number of children (height 1.1m) in the ticket pricing information
Locate the ticket price for children (height 1.1m) in the pricing table
Locate the ticket price for students (height 1.3m) in the pricing table
Multiply the number of children by the children's ticket price to get total children cost
Locate the number of students (height 1.3m) in the ticket pricing information
Locate the ticket price for 71-year-old elderly in the pricing table
Multiply the number of students by the student ticket price to get total student cost
Locate the number of 71-year-old elderly in the ticket pricing information
Multiply the number of 71-year-old elderly by their ticket price to get total elderly 71 cost
Locate the number of 65-year-old elderly in the ticket pricing information
Locate the ticket price for 65-year-old elderly in the pricing table
Multiply the number of 65-year-old elderly by their ticket price to get total elderly 65 cost
Sum all group costs (children, students, elderly 71, elderly 65) to get total cost
